noticeText: The death has occurred of Bridget (Bríd) COLLINS (nee Keating) late of Church Street, Carrigaholt, Co. Clare on July 1, 2006.Removal this (Monday) evening from Lillis's Funeral Home, Kilkee at 8 o'clock to St. Mary's Church, Carrigaholt. Funeral tomorrow (Tuesday) after 12 o'clock. Requiem Mass to Moyarta Cemetery. May she rest in peace
